origin.description: Any real power of the shrinkage correlation matrix.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A data matrix, one observation per row.

arguments.name: lambda
arguments.text: Correlation shrinkage intensity from 0 to 1. Omitted means estimate it. In Python the name is lambda_value.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per row. Omitted means equal weights that sum to 1.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.text: Print the intensity. The default is true.

origin.details: Intensity 1 or exponent 0 returns the identity. Exponent 1 skips the eigendecomposition. A zero intensity that is rank deficient warns and uses the pseudoinverse.
origin.value: A matrix the size of the correlation, with the intensity attached.
